mybiblelens.headline: Waxa muhiimka ah u hay meel dhow.
mybiblelens.intro: Ururin yar oo alaab si fiican looga fikiray ah, loogu talagalay qoraallada, xusuusinta, iyo socodka maalinlaha ah ee Ilaah lala socdo.

wordTee.name: The Word Tee
wordTee.detail: Lakab jilicsan oo maalin kasta ah

watercheck.headline: Biyo cab. Sii socod.
watercheck.intro: Dhar loogu talagalay dadka biyaha ka fikira: kuwa yimaada, dhalada dib u buuxiya, Check-gana sii wada.

collection.title: Loo sameeyay inay qayb ka noqdaan maalintaada.
collection.body: Kuwani waa alaabta ugu horreysa. Sawirrada alaabta, doorashooyinka, iyo linkiyada lacag-bixinta halkan ayay ka soo muuqan doonaan marka soo saarku diyaar noqdo.

checkout.title: Marka uu furmo, lacag-bixintu way fududaan doontaa.
checkout.body: Dooro shay, taabo Iibso hadda, oo si ammaan ah ugu bixi Stripe. Ma jiro akoon dukaan, mana jiro wareer gaadhi-iibsi.
